what Does bee think of Holy? -
Holy, what can I say that I’m sure others haven’t already?
It’s fitting that you’re a Holy Cake Priest, because your spirit truly shines through — whether it’s with friends or on stream.
Your laugh and your general attitude are infectious to everyone around you. You’re always willing to help or cheer someone up, and you genuinely care about the people in your life.
You always make time, even when you’re busy or tired, just to check in.
When we first met, I already knew who you were from the way your friends talked about you. I’ve never met anyone who knew you and could say you were anything less than a great guy.
So when I finally got to watch your stream — after only seeing you pop into my chat a handful of times — I really wanted to be your friend.
Since then, becoming your friend and being welcomed into your friend group with Butt Juice, Shoko, Tay, and everyone that Chuckles snuck me in with hehe, I’ve had so much fun.
So many laughs. So many WTF moments. More than I could ever count.
I am so grateful that you were born, and that I got the chance to become your friend.
I hope this is the first of many birthdays I get to spend with you.
Happy Birthday Holy 🎉💜
